answer.text: The low beam headlamp is 12.12 W.
The manual gives 14.22 W for high beam and low beam together.

watchouts.text: Bulbs or electrical gadgets rated other than the specified rating will lead to overloading, erratic behavior or premature failure of the electrical system.

disclaimers.text: The manual does not give the high beam wattage on its own.

watchout_review.reason: Electrical ratings that differ from the specified values bear on the wattage figures asked.
Covers unapproved modifications and warranty, not the wattage figures asked.
